description: The plot illustrates the performance, measured as ASR, for different trigger words. The x-axis is labeled “”, with tick labels representing trigger words: “cf”, “bb”, “WNBA”, “ESPN”, “NHL”, “FIFA”, “Estadio”, and “athletics”. The scale is categorical. The y-axis is labeled “ASR”, with a linear scale ranging from 0.5 to 0.95, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. There are three lines depicted: a green line with circle markers representing “start” begins at approximately 0.73 and ends at approximately 0.85, with a peak at approximately 0.92; an orange line with ‘x’ markers representing “random” begins at approximately 0.65 and ends at approximately 0.83, with a peak at approximately 0.91; and a purple line with circle markers representing “end” begins at approximately 0.77 and ends at approximately 0.84, with a peak at approximately 0.95.
